summary: Terraform configuration contains security risks related to network access and IAM permissions.

findings.title: Unrestricted SSH Access
findings.description: The security group allows inbound SSH traffic from all IPv4 addresses.
findings.recommendation: Restrict SSH ingress to authorized IP ranges.

findings.title: Overly Permissive IAM Policy
findings.description: The IAM policy grants overly broad permissions.
findings.recommendation: Apply least-privilege permissions based on actual infrastructure requirements.

findings.title: Unrestricted Outbound Traffic
findings.description: The security group allows unrestricted outbound traffic, which requires review.
findings.recommendation: Review outbound requirements and restrict unnecessary access.

attack_analysis: No Terraform-specific attack logs were provided. No successful exploitation is confirmed.
tests: Run terraform validate after initializing the required providers.
